title: Use readable platform font sizes

statement.ja: documented platformのdefaultおよびminimum以上の読みやすいfont sizeを使う。

conditions: Use default/minimum sizes of 17/11 pt on iOS and iPadOS, 13/10 pt on macOS, and 29/23 pt on tvOS.

When a custom font has a thin weight, aim above the recommended sizes.
